title: Submission block
description: The `submission` object inside delivery.json of a delivery offered as a pull request (guide 4, section 8). The rest of delivery.json is a delivery manifest (manifest.schema.json).

handle.description: the public account name the pull request is opened from; no personal data is needed

licence.description: licence identifier of the whole delivery; the profile lists the ones it takes (submission.allowedLicences)

profile.description: the profile the delivery was checked against; when profiles/<name>.json exists, CI checks against it as well as against the default

toolVersions.description: tool or library name to version, for example the guide set and the IFC library used to write the files

ownWork.description: the submitter made the work, or has the right to offer it

mayLicense.description: the submitter may license it under the licence stated above

noRestrictedContent.description: the delivery contains no third-party restricted content
